filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. For 'PHP PDO Connection' in Arabic, a high-level conceptual video was chosen due to a lack of quality, focused tutorials. All other topics have excellent, highly relevant videos. The selections prioritize clarity, modern techniques (like PDO where possible), and strong visual explanations for abstract concepts, difficult concepts like Normalization and SQL Joins.
